value.rationale: The sixteen-vertex regular four-cube is a canonical natural graph, and cut size four tests beyond the available girth-six topological regime. The complete mixed integral wedge type has homology in two adjacent degrees and proves non-shellability of a pure 11-dimensional complex; it is an exact natural invariant rather than an arbitrary slice.
